description: Every collector channel of the caller, with state and live numbers, in one response. One call for the whole fleet — one query to the time-series store for all channels, never one per device. It is the same function the dashboard subscribes to over the socket (`/api/inputs/serie`), where the input central then pushes `inputs.updated` and `inputs.removed` events; integrators get the same data here without the socket. A failed input-central request or an invalid fleet response returns 503 inputs_unavailable, never a successful empty fleet. Fleet reads give the input-central exchange, including its response body, a 750 ms deadline. The optional time-series query has a 400 ms deadline; when it is unavailable or too slow, channels are preserved with stats null. An authenticated owner with no channels still gets an empty list.
name: list_input_fleet
title: List input fleet
